context.body: Prayer, apparent abandonment, death, temple rupture, cosmic signs, and confession occur together.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus addresses “my God” in abandonment, cries again, dies, and is followed by torn curtain, earthquake, opened tombs, and the centurion’s confession.
observations.label: Jesus cries to God and dies: action

observations.body: Bystanders misunderstand the cry; the centurion and guards fear and name Jesus God’s Son.
observations.label: Jesus cries to God and dies: response

observations.body: my God · forsaken · yielded up spirit · Son of God
observations.label: Words in Matthew 27:45–54

payload.posture: Read Matthew 27:45–54 as jesus names the father evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The narrative voices abandonment without stating that the relation between Father and Son has ceased.
payload.title: Jesus cries to God and dies
